name: stackoverflow
description: Search Stack Overflow for programming questions and accepted answers. Free via the Stack Exchange API (no key, soft 300 req/day cap). Use when the user has a specific technical/coding problem someone else has probably hit before.

query.description: Technical question or error message keywords.

tag.description: Optional Stack Overflow tag to scope the search (e.g. 'python', 'rust', 'typescript').
